newsitem.title: UK: UK's Major rejects criticism of jobless data.
newsitem.headline: UK's Major rejects criticism of jobless data.

text.p: British Prime Minister John Major said on Wednesday that claims unemployment was really 1.7 million higher than official figures showed were rubbish.
"Total and utter rubbish," said John Major when asked about the claims at a news conference.
"British unemployment is falling whatever measure you care to use," Major said.

"Unemployment is falling in this country, falling rapidly, falling in a way it isn't anywhere in the European Union and the number of people in work is also rising as well as the unemployment figures are falling."

On Wednesday, several daily newspapers said the government had confessed to the failings of its own official statistics in a submission to the European Commission, saying the data understate the problem.
Official figures out on Wednesday showed unemployment fell 41,100 in March, giving a rate of 6.1 percent.
